summary: Iteration 2 testing for Portech site (FastAPI + React). Backend: 22/23 pytest tests pass — login (PortechAdmin/Portech2026!), /api/contact with new fields (company optional, work_location required + 422 validation), Resend email_sent=true, /api/admin/stats, /api/admin/submissions DELETE, /api/auth/me, logout. Frontend: All requested UI elements verified — /mentions-legales shows mentions + Politique Loi 25 + Cédrick Pimparé + portech.infos@gmail.com; footer-link-legal navigates correctly; founder-name shows 'CÉDRICK PIMPARÉ'; services-scope shows 'LA QUINCAILLERIE — C'EST TOUT CE QU'ON FAIT.'; home-brands has all 12 brands (Adams Rite, Von Duprin, Sargent, LCN, Schlage, Yale, Norton, dormakaba, Corbin Russwin, Best, Hager, Stanley); home-sectors marquee includes Cinémas/Banques/Dépanneurs; contact form has contact-input-company + contact-input-work-location fields and full E2E submission shows success message 'DEMANDE ENVOYÉE'.

critical.issue: Returns 500 ResponseValidationError because legacy submissions in DB don't have 'work_location' (newly required field). 'Field required' on response item index 3. The admin dashboard cannot list submissions until legacy data is migrated or response model is made tolerant.

action_items: Fix GET /api/admin/submissions 500: either (a) make ContactSubmission.work_location Optional with default '' for response model, or (b) migrate existing MongoDB docs to add work_location='' where missing (e.g., db.contact_submissions.update_many({work_location: {$exists: false}}, {$set: {work_location: ''}})), or (c) coerce missing work_location to '' in the list endpoint before returning. Recommended: option (a) for backwards-compatibility on the response model while keeping ContactSubmissionCreate strict.
critical_code_review_comments: ContactSubmission output model has work_location as required, but legacy DB docs predate this field — causes 500 on /api/admin/submissions. Production resilience requires the response model to tolerate missing/empty work_location on read.

server.py /auth/me endpoint and others log 401 on every page load because the frontend probably probes session on every public page — consider gating the /auth/me check to admin routes only to reduce console noise (currently 2 x 401 console errors on each public page).

seed_admin() rehashes the admin password every restart if it doesn't match env — fine, but means changing ADMIN_PASSWORD in .env will silently invalidate any tokens and overwrite manual changes in DB. Document this behavior.

rca of the issue: RCA: ContactSubmission Pydantic model declares work_location as required (Field(..., min_length=1)). FastAPI uses this same model as response_model for GET /api/admin/submissions. When MongoDB returns documents inserted before the field existed (e.g., id=60ca31bd-7d2e-4536-8972-2c89e746b510), Pydantic raises ResponseValidationError → FastAPI converts to 500. Reproduction: login as admin, GET /api/admin/submissions → 500. Mitigation options listed in action_items.
